summary.en: No additional papers selected from today's accessible sources; incomplete access limits coverage.
summary.zh: 今天在可访问来源中暂未选出可新增收录的论文；访问限制使覆盖范围不完整。

en: No additional papers were selected for this brief. Among the material accessible today, no new candidate could be sufficiently verified against primary sources and publication versions for inclusion. This does not mean that no relevant papers were published.

The search covered indexed Nature Methods and Nature Communications subject pages, ACS journal indexes for Journal of Proteome Research, Analytical Chemistry and Journal of the American Society for Mass Spectrometry, the bioRxiv November directory, and targeted searches spanning proteomics, metabolomics, lipidomics, mass spectrometry imaging and ion mobility. Some ACS early-publication pages and Nature article pages were inaccessible, so coverage is incomplete.
zh: 本期暂未新增收录论文。在今天可访问的资料中，尚无新的候选论文能够完成收录所需的原始来源与发表版本核验。这并不表示没有相关论文发表。

检索涉及已索引的 Nature Methods 和 Nature Communications 学科页面，Journal of Proteome Research、Analytical Chemistry 和 Journal of the American Society for Mass Spectrometry 的 ACS 期刊索引，bioRxiv 十一月目录，以及蛋白质组学、代谢组学、脂质组学、质谱成像和离子淌度方向的定向检索。部分 ACS 在线优先发表页面和 Nature 文章页面无法访问，因此覆盖范围不完整。
